description: This file defines the SocketsTrace class, which implements the ISocketsTrace interface. It provides logging functionalities for socket connection events such as read, write, error, reset, pause, resume, and FIN signals, utilizing Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.

classes.name: SocketsTrace
classes.description: A partial class implementing ISocketsTrace, responsible for logging socket connection events.

methods.name: ConnectionRead
methods.description: Method intended to log a connection read event; currently does not log to avoid verbosity.

methods.name: ConnectionWrite
methods.description: Method intended to log a connection write event; currently does not log to avoid verbosity.

methods.name: ConnectionWriteCallback
methods.description: Method intended to log a callback after connection write; currently does not log to avoid verbosity.

methods.name: ConnectionError
methods.description: Logs a connection error with exception details.

methods.name: ConnectionReset
methods.description: Logs that a connection has been reset.

methods.name: ConnectionPause
methods.description: Logs that a connection has been paused.

methods.name: ConnectionResume
methods.description: Logs that a connection has been resumed.

methods.name: BeginScope
methods.description: Begins a logging scope with the provided state.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific log level is enabled.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified log level, event ID, state, exception, and formatter.
